Definition: Sum of daily abnormal returns (firm return minus CRSP value-weighted market return) over trading days 0 to +30, where day 0 is the trading day nearest the breach date
Source: CRSP daily stock file; CRSP market index
Timing: Trading days 0 to +30 around the breach date

Definition: Same as the 30-day CAR over trading days 0 to +5
Sum of daily abnormal returns over a window before day 0: [-30,-21], [-20,-11] or [-10,-1]; day 0 is the trading day nearest the breach date (Panels A-C) or the reported disclosure date (Panels D-F)
Mean of log(daily volume / shares outstanding) over trading days -5 to +25, minus its mean over trading days -240 to -60
Source: CRSP daily volume and shares outstanding
Timing: Event window vs. a pre-event baseline

Definition: 1 if the breached organization was a registered FCC Form 499 telecommunications filer with registration covering the breach date (subject to the FCC seven-day rule); 0 otherwise
Source: FCC Form 499 filer registry (export of 2026-07-21); 22 documented adjudication rules

Definition: 1 if the reported (public notification) date is no more than 7 calendar days after the breach date; missing when the delay is missing
Source: Privacy Rights Clearinghouse (PRC) breach and reported dates

Definition: Calendar days from the breach date to the reported date. Reported dates up to 30 days before the breach date are set to 0; more than 30 days before, set to missing (source-data error)
Number of other verified breach events at the same parent company (CIK) in the 365 days before this breach
Source: PRC, after de-duplication to breach events

Definition: 1 if prior breaches (past 12 months) is greater than zero
1 if the source record's compromised-information field mentions medical or health data, or the organization type is medical (MED)
Natural log of total assets (Compustat AT, $ millions)
Timing: Latest fiscal year ending before the breach date (within 550 days)

Definition: Total liabilities (Compustat LT) divided by total assets (AT)
Timing: Latest fiscal year ending before the breach date (within 550 days)

Definition: Net income (Compustat NI) divided by total assets (AT)
Timing: Latest fiscal year ending before the breach date (within 550 days)

Definition: (Sales - cost of goods sold - SG&A) / sales
Timing: Latest fiscal year ending before the breach date

Definition: Largest number of affected individuals reported across the source filings for the event
Calendar days from the breach date to the first Form 8-K the firm filed in the 90 days after it; events with no 8-K in that window have no gap
1 if the firm filed any Form 8-K in the 90 days after the breach date
Market excess return (Mkt-RF), size (SMB) and value (HML) factor values for the month of the breach
One indicator per calendar year of the breach date
